engine: Isolated V8 actual new module, original calendar and extracted equity validation/canonicalization; deterministic digest substitute and test/assert harness. Not native Node or full repository.

tests.name: C9.1 two comparable deteriorations after observed crowding identify a shadow collapse candidate only
C9.1 one decline is divergence, never confirmed collapse
C9.1 single snapshot or repeated quote cannot manufacture consecutive evidence
C9.1 mismatched member source or membership breaks continuity
C9.1 latest missing, conflict, stale or future receipt cannot resurrect older current risk claim
C9.1 a gap or cross-session transition cannot be counted as continuous decline
C9.1 two genuine improvements may show repair candidate, never automatic recovery
C9.2 eight distinct dimensions stay unknown without their own evidence, no fabricated score
C9.2 missing, future, wrong-symbol and incomplete evidence never mark a dimension not triggered
C9.2 conflicting evidence cannot produce a safe dimension and shared roots are not independent votes
C9.3 original enabled restriction and retained severe risk override any model agreement or positive score
C9.3 current original data/rule uncertainty remains first priority, another security risk is not attributed to candidate
C9.4 original held quantity, zero sellable and partial sellability stay separate
C9.4 flat and active order without holding are distinct, unknown active order is not free budget
C9.4 cross-account, replica, stale or damaged sealed equity never supplies private holding quantities
C9.5 model disagreement, different horizons and future data actively abstain
C9.5 identical model copies are not multiple opinions, conflicting copies remain conflict
C9.5 agreement does not authorize or calibrate a probability, even when all eight dimensions appear clear
C9.1 later wrapper cannot refresh stale member quote or rollback revision into continuous decline
C9.2 visible invalid or retracted dimension row cannot vanish beside old clear evidence, future row remains invisible
C9.3 same root retains both hard original and unknown evidence with top priority, not duplicate reasons
C9.5 different model names cannot multiply one copied output reference
